context.hint: Review ownership and validation of deduplication identifiers used by an import service.
context.surface: An event service accepts ordinary writes and uses system-managed identifiers to make imports repeatable.
assumptions: The application distinguishes ordinary writes from trusted import processing.
Use a disposable fixture and synthetic records to verify the storage boundary.

review.invariant: The trusted import path can still use its system-managed identifiers to keep legitimate retries idempotent.
review.verification: At the adapter boundary, check that a valid import retains access to its assigned deduplication identifier and uses the same identifier on a legitimate retry. Verify that ordinary writes keep their existing validation.

source_observation.summary: The targeted suite verified that trusted import processing could still supply its system-managed identifier through the application boundary. End-to-end retry behavior in a live database was outside this verification.
